2. If something is smart then it is green. (Rule) → Charlie is green. (From 1)  
3. Charlie is smart and Charlie is green. (From 1 and 2)  
4. All smart, green things are furry. (Rule) → Charlie is furry. (From 3)  
5. All furry things are white. (Rule) → Charlie is white. (From 4)  

Since we have derived that Charlie is white, the statement “Charlie is not white” does not follow.

ANSWER: False
